headline: Head-high-plus S swell with light offshore morning — the day of the week, no contest.
today: This is the standout: 3-4ft-plus at a good angle with NNW offshore in the morning and near-glassy light E winds into midday. Surf the morning around the low-to-incoming tide and enjoy the size while it lasts before the SE onshore creeps in at evening. Shortboard weather — bring the everyday board.

daysToWatch.note: Drops to chest-high but it's a prime angle with light NNW dawn winds — clean early session before the S onshore fills in the afternoon.
Back to 3ft-ish with a cross-off dawn, so early could clean up before the W/SW cross and evening wind messes it up. Worth a dawn check.
